journal_lines: Chert nodules in the limestone. Useful.
Flint strikes well. Kept the best pieces.
Gravel in a dry pocket. Worked through quickly.
Good chert in the limestone. Dense and workable.
Found flint nodules in a band running through the chalk.
River-rounded flint, carried here by old water. Dense.
Sharp-edged pieces from a recent fracture. Useful.
The gravel layer three feet down. Sieved it patiently.
Flint in the clay, brown-red nodules. Took the best.
Conchoidal fracture on every piece. Clean flint.
Good knapping stock in this gravel. Packed carefully.
The largest nodule the size of a fist. Excellent.
Found a vein of flint in the chalk, not loose. Worked it out.
Silica band in the limestone. Not rare here, but always useful.
